accepted.evidence: Turner explicitly records Darrai Pashai lām under grāma village. Lehr gives lām home, village, retaining the broader local gloss.

Turner section 2 *dhaura² explicitly records Pashai dōr face, mouth, side. Lehr Darrai dōr face corresponds in form and sense; the installed CDIAL graph has one node for the entire 6884 article, so the section is specified here.
Turner section 1 *bhakkha explicitly records Darrai Pashai bakoṭā́ stout, fat. Lehr Darrai bakoṭa fat is the same lexeme; section 2 *bhikkha is excluded.

Turner section 1 *pāḍḍa explicitly records Darrai and Nuristani Pashai pāṛek goat, precisely matching Lehr Darrai pāṛek. Section 2 *pēḍḍa is excluded; Turner notes probable Dravidian origin for the deeper etymon.
Turner explicitly records Pashai Laurowan nām and other regional nām name forms under nāman. Lehr Darrai nām name matches; the addendum questions a Persian loan only for Khowar, not Pashai.

held.reason: The nearby CDIAL Pashai āṇḍa is marked as borrowed from Indic and does not establish Lehr aṇā or its immediate donor.
CDIAL Pashai kan/kaṇḍ refers to an ear orifice, but correspondence to Lehr kāṛ remains unverified.
CDIAL Pashai ačhī/aᵉċ lacks the nasal in Lehr ainc; no secure analysis yet.
